preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input.
The input contains at least one token (the number of test cases T).

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for line in stdin.strip().split()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['WIN', 'LOSE'] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'WIN' or 'LOSE'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'WIN') == (s.count('1') % 2 == 1) for line, s in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), stdin.strip().split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is 'WIN' if and only if the count of '1's in s is odd; otherwise it is 'LOSE'.
